</span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">If we issue and sell additional shares of our common stock in the future, our existing stockholders will be diluted and our stock price could fall.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:36pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">Our principal stockholders own a significant percentage of our stock and will be able to exert significant control over matters subject to stockholder approval.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:36pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">Our limited number of employees subjects us to significant resource constraints, which may hinder our ability to comply with public company regulations and manage our operations effectively.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:36pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">We have never paid dividends on our capital stock, and we do not anticipate paying any cash dividends in the foreseeable future.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:36pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">The exercise of warrants to purchase our common stock will increase the number of outstanding shares in the public market and result in dilution to our stockholders.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:36pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">If securities or industry analysts do not publish research or publish inaccurate or unfavorable research about our business, our stock price and trading volume could decline.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-align:center; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">iv</span></p><div><hr style="width: 100%; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; margin: 1rem 0;"/></div><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt"><span>&#160;</span></p></div><div class="Section_7"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-align:center; line-height:12pt"><a id="bm_f662f9264489a6fa" href="#"></a><span style="font-size:10pt; font-weight:bold">PART I </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span></span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><a id="bm_871067d828729680" href="#"></a><span style="font-size:10pt; font-weight:bold">Item 1. </span><a href="#TOC" style="text-decoration:none"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-weight:bold; color:#000000">Business.</span></a></p><p style="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:10pt; line-height:12pt"><span></span><span style="font-size:10pt; font-weight:bold">Overview</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">We are the</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">market leader in delivering resilient, next generation, complementary positioning, navigation and timing (&#8220;PNT&#8221;) solutions designed to overcome the limitations and vulnerabilities of existing space-based Global Navigation Satellite Systems (&#8220;GNSS&#8221;), including the Global Positioning System (&#8220;GPS&#8221;).</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt"> PNT services are used in nearly every facet of our economy. Cellular and electrical distribution systems depend on GPS-based timing, and the mobile app economy relies on location to create innovative services and to drive data and advertising revenue.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">Public safety and enhanced 911 (&#8220;E911&#8221;) save lives every day with the use of location services.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">GPS has powered the global economy for nearly 40 years. Without high-precision timing from GPS, cellular systems would fail, the distribution of electricity would be impacted, and other aspects of everyday life would be adversely affected.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">Recent international events have demonstrated that having viable systems to backup and complement GPS is a national security issue.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">Our PNT solutions seek to address these needs and issues in several ways.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">Our technology consists of a ground-based transmitter network operating on low-band spectrum assets in a manner similar to the function of GPS satellites.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">Unlike satellites, our network signals are designed to be much stronger and extremely difficult to jam or spoof.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">In addition, because the signals are terrestrial and low-band, they can penetrate buildings.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">As a result, our technology can act as a complement to satellite-based GPS, especially in urban canyons or deep indoors, and as a backup in case traditional GPS fails due to jamming, spoofing, technical failures, solar flares or other risks to satellite-based services.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">In addition, our location-based services are three-dimensional. Our core Pinnacle technology uses barometric sensors in smartphones and other communications devices and a network of sensors to determine vertical, or &#8220;z-axis&#8221;, location.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">This technology can provide accurate vertical location data to assist first responders, dispatchers and others, or potentially could be used for autonomous systems, such as drones, in need of precise 3D mapping in urban areas, among other uses. </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; font-size:10pt"><span>&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">Our complementary PNT solutions are built on our asset base of FCC licenses that cover 12 MHz of low-band spectrum available for use.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">This spectrum consists of a contiguous</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">8</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">MHz block of</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">900 MHz spectrum covering over</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">90% of the U.S. population and an additional</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">4</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">MHz of complementary spectrum</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">covering part of the U.S. population that was transferred to us in 2025 as a result of a transaction with Telesaurus and Skybridge Spectrum Foundation. That transaction also gave us potential rights to an additional 2 MHz of related spectrum covered by terminated Skybridge Spectrum Foundation licenses.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">These licenses are subject to a Skybridge and Telesaurus petition for reconsideration seeking reinstatement of these licenses.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">For more information on this transaction, refer to Note 3 to our consolidated financial statements for the twelve months ended December 31, 2025 included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt"> </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt; background-color:#ffffff"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt; background-color:#ffffff"><span style="font-size:10pt">We are evolving our PNT solutions to use 5G New Radio (&#8220;5G NR&#8221;) positioning reference signals (&#8220;PRS&#8221;), under the 3GPP global standard, to determine location and timing - a platform we refer to as NextGen.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">We believe the evolution of our existing technologies and services to a 5G NR PRS capability will improve the efficiency, flexibility, and scale of our operations. 5G NR technologies drive enhanced network performance, capacity, and efficiency across multiple industry verticals. 5G NR enables low-latency, high-throughput connectivity and also improves spectral efficiency, which allows operators to increase returns on investment in licensed spectrum and, with respect to our technology, to improve both the density and availability of PNT signals. 5G NR can also support many different applications, including ultra-reliable low-latency communications (URLLC), enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB), and massive machine-type communications (mMTC). These capabilities permit 5G NR to support high-performance broadband services as well as emerging use cases in autonomous systems, industrial automation, and the Internet of Things (IoT).</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">As a result, spectrum that can support 5G technologies and services is important to broadband providers and their customers. </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt; background-color:#ffffff"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt; background-color:#ffffff"><span style="font-size:10pt">To enable our evolution to 5G NR, we have filed a Petition for Rulemaking (the &#8220;Petition&#8221;) asking the FCC to optimize the Lower 900 MHz radio spectrum band to enable 5G NR operations, the delivery of PNT via a 5G broadband network and in turn support such 5G technologies and services.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">Our Petition requests the FCC allow us to use a single, nationwide 15 MHz spectrum configuration for both PNT and 5G broadband.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">The Petition is subject to an ongoing FCC regulatory review process, and was referenced in the FCC&#8217;s March 27, 2025 PNT Notice of Inquiry.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt; background-color:#ffffff"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt; background-color:#ffffff"><span style="font-size:10pt">Under</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">our proposal, the FCC would</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">create a 5</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">MHz uplink and 10</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">MHz downlink</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">suitable for 5G operations.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">We believe</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">modernizing the Lower&#8239;900&#8239;MHz band will simultaneously enable a high-quality terrestrial PNT network to complement and back up GPS, addressing</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">a critical</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">national security vulnerability, and</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">add&#8239;5G broadband capacity.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">As such, our NextGen capability is being designed with the goal of enabling one or more</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">mobile network</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">operators or other partners to integrate this optimized Lower 900 MHz spectrum into their</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">5G network</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">deployments. We expect that these partnerships</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">would</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">result in wide-scale availability of our complementary PNT services and, for our potential partners,</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">additional</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">5G broadband capacity.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt; background-color:#ffffff"><span style="font-size:10pt">&#8239;</span></p><div style="-aw-sdt-tag:'PG_ba1a9f53e58d9acd'"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-align:center; font-size:10pt"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';  font-size: 10pt;">1</span></p><div><hr style="width: 100%; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; margin: 1rem 0;"/></div></div></div><div class="Section_8"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">The backbone of wireless data services, electromagnetic spectrum, is a finite resource.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">Our spectrum licenses, which lie in the Lower</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">900</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">MHz band, are referred to as &#8220;low-band spectrum.&#8221;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">There is a finite amount of low-band spectrum available, and</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">low-band spectrum has favorable coverage characteristics compared to higher frequencies, including the ability to provide services indoors and over greater distances.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">These characteristics result in its ability to be used for coverage and to be deployed more economically, with higher-frequency spectrum often used to provide additional capacity in targeted locations.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">The transition to</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">5G NR for our PNT services will provide a technical capability to support broadband data services, which, subject to appropriate regulatory approvals, would allow the spectrum to be used to help meet the continued, growing demand for wireless data capacity. </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">A core element of our strategy is to pursue such partnerships to offset the costs of deploying and operating a widescale, terrestrial PNT network that can act as a complement and backup to GPS. While GPS is fully supported by the U.S. government, we believe it is unlikely that the U.S. government would subsidize an extensive, standalone terrestrial PNT network and other revenue-generating opportunities are limited, given existing use of GPS. However, we believe there is a financially viable path to a widescale terrestrial PNT network that meets critical national security needs through the spectrum optimization proposed by our Petition that would allow it to be used for 5G.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt; background-color:#ffffff"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-weight:bold">Our Solutions </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt; background-color:#ffffff"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-weight:bold;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">As we evolve our technology platform to NextGen and pursue regulatory changes to the Lower 900 MHz band and our spectrum licenses, we continue to deliver high-quality PNT services through our existing solutions.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">Our location systems have been engineered to provide comprehensive solutions to the limitations and vulnerabilities inherent in</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">GPS and other satellite-based services. Key GPS limitations include:</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">Low signal strength resulting in poor building/indoor penetration, limitations in urban areas;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">Vulnerability to jamming;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">Poor vertical accuracy in most devices, which impacts any service where altitude is relevant (e.g., multi-level structures, vertical separation in low-altitude aviation);</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">The primary consumer GPS signal is unencrypted, resulting in poor location security and spoofing;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">Inherent physical vulnerability due to few, isolated transmitters; and</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; text-align:justify; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">Single point of failure for a wide range of PNT services.</span></p><p style="margin-top:10pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">Our existing service platforms consist of Pinnacle, our altitude (z-axis) solution,</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">and TerraPoiNT, which is similar to a terrestrial GPS constellation, in addition to our continued development of NextGen to bring complementary, high-quality PNT capabilities to a standards-based 5G NR broadband platform. Although we currently provide TerraPoiNT services to customers, going forward, we anticipate transitioning to our NextGen solution when it becomes commercially ready, which is intended in part to leverage legacy TerraPoiNT&#8217;s technology and service delivery platform and adapt it to 5G.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;&#160; </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">NextGen</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">PNT systems are the core services provided by GPS, and NextGen can be thought of as a shared, land-based GPS satellite constellation, operating simultaneously with 5G broadband data services. We expect that</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">NextGen services will be naturally resilient to service disruption and significantly more resistant to jamming than GPS. If GPS is disrupted or destroyed, a NextGen transmitter is designed to continue to operate and provide similar service within the NextGen service area. If one NextGen transmitter is disrupted, service is designed to continue from other nearby transmitters. Thus, there is the potential for both local- and wide-area resilience embedded in the basic system design. Our NextGen services are expected to leverage proven cellular infrastructure, which has been designed to provide wide-scale coverage, and is expected to be able to complement GPS by extending PNT availability to urban canyons and indoor locations where GPS reception is challenging. </span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">We anticipate NextGen will increase our spectrum utilization significantly, allowing us to offer both high-quality PNT services and broadband data using the same spectrum. This increased data transmission capacity could be used, subject to FCC approval, to provide other types of 5G NR-based two-way voice and data transmission services while simultaneously delivering PNT information. Our plans to deploy NextGen with one or more network partners could result in minimal capital expenditures by us related to the operation of our high-quality PNT services, while our partner(s) would benefit from the proven economics of additional broadband capacity. </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><div style="-aw-sdt-tag:'PG_24c9d734e5c1c10e'"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-align:center; font-size:10pt"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';  font-size: 10pt;">2</span></p><div><hr style="width: 100%; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; margin: 1rem 0;"/></div></div></div><div class="Section_9"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:10pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">Pinnacle </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">As we evolve our technology platform to NextGen and pursue regulatory changes to the Lower 900 MHz band and our spectrum licenses, we continue to deliver high-quality PNT services through our Pinnacle solution. Our Pinnacle solution, launched in partnership with AT&amp;T Services, Inc. (&#8220;AT&amp;T&#8221;) as part of its</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">FirstNet</span><span style="font-size:6.67pt; vertical-align:super">&#174;</span><span style="font-size:6.67pt; vertical-align:super">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">initiative, can provide accurate</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">altitude service to any device with a barometric pressure sensor and</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">covers over 90% of commercial structures over</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">three</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">stories in the U.S.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">Our Pinnacle system is</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">primarily used for public safety applications, including E911 for</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">Verizon Communications, Inc. (&#8220;Verizon&#8221;), and a growing number of devices operating on the remaining national cellular network providers.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">This service is currently available in the top 105 major U.S. markets, which include more than 4,400 cities and more than 90% of commercial buildings that exceed three stories. In November 2022, Pinnacle service was launched by MetCom in Japan, and our partnership with MetCom has expanded through a technology and services agreement signed in 2025. The technologies underlying Pinnacle are planned to be incorporated into NextGen.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">Because our Pinnacle technology relies on measurements available with the hardware currently used in most mobile phones and tablets, it can be made available for mass market applications, as well as enterprise, public safety, and other applications. Our Pinnacle service is delivered to customers over an applications programming interface</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">(&#8220;API&#8221;) or via a software development kit (&#8220;SDK&#8221;) integrated into the relevant applications.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:10pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">TerraPoiNT</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">TerraPoiNT is our prior-generation 3D PNT system, operating like a land-based GPS satellite constellation, like our planned NextGen solution. Our</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">TerraPoiNT system is a terrestrially based dedicated, complementary PNT network designed to overcome the limitations inherent in the space-based nature of GPS.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">Furthermore, the TerraPoiNT signal can embed Pinnacle information to provide a full</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">three-dimensional PNT solution. TerraPoiNT was designed to maximize compatibility with GPS and other GNSS receivers. TerraPoiNT service is made available through a highly distributed terrestrial network of transmitters and is naturally resilient to service disruption and significantly more resistant to jamming than GPS. </span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">Through a contract with the U.S. Department of Transportation (&#8220;DoT&#8221;), we are establishing performance characteristics for TerraPoiNT to allow</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">DoT to incorporate our solutions into a clearinghouse of PNT solutions for potential acquisition by Federal government customers, as defined in the DoT Complementary PNT Action Plan.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-weight:bold">Our Strategy</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-weight:bold">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">Domestically, we operate primarily as a service provider, leveraging our intellectual property, spectrum assets, and partnerships with key customers. Our target customers include wireless carriers, applications developers, and adjacent businesses selling PNT products and systems to end users, and Federal, state, and local governmental entities. Subject to regulatory approvals and the successful evolution of our technology to align with 5G NR standards,</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">our NextGen platform and spectrum can be used to offer both high-quality PNT and high-bandwidth data capabilities.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt"> We deploy sensor and network capabilities, either directly or with our customers and partners, and license access to our technologies and the data generated by our networks to our customers. Internationally, we are pursuing collaborative relationships through licensing our technology and providing related services</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">to enable our partners to commercialize our solutions in their home markets. The key elements of our strategy include:</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:116%; font-size:10pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-style:italic">Continue to build on our leadership in complementary PNT.</span><span> We anticipate that the expanded availability of our systems, especially NextGen, will provide enhanced value to existing customers and open new vertical markets. In addition to our relationship with FirstNet&#174;, built with AT&amp;T, and our public safety offerings, we are continuing to grow our E911 service, including with Verizon, and have licensed our technology to device manufacturers operating on other nationwide wireless carriers. In addition, we plan to continue to work closely with the DoT and other agencies to drive adoption of our PNT solutions as a national</span><span>&#160;</span><span>complement to, and backup capabilities for, GPS.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">Evolve our system to be fully aligned with </span><span style="font-size:10pt">5</span><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">G NR standards, to enable a terrestrial PNT platform that evolves with global mobile network standards. </span><span style="font-size:10pt">Evolving</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">the technical foundation of our system to 5G NR will allow us to provide</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">high-quality PNT services in conjunction with 5G broadband services.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">We anticipate that this may allow us to significantly increase the scope of potential customers and partners, reduce our time to market, improve the geographic coverage of our business, and align our operations with the mainstream global cellular ecosystem. Collectively, we anticipate these benefits will increase the potential reach of our services. Our objective is to operate our NextGen PNT services in partnership with one or more broadband partners, assuming we are successful with the Petition.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">Pursue our Petition with the FCC to optimize</span><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">rules governing the Lower 900 MHz band</span><span style="font-size:10pt">. It is a priority of the Company to secure</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">appropriate regulatory</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">approvals to maximize the use of our spectrum and enable the delivery of a widescale complementary</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">5G-based</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">PNT solution. We are engaged with the FCC, stakeholders in the Lower</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">900</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">MHz band, and other stakeholders in the industry in seeking to ensure the availability of wide-scale complementary PNT services.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">Pursue partnerships to use the 5G broadband capacity.</span><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">As discussed, if our Petition is granted, we will seek to enter into partnerships with mobile operators and others who could take advantage of the newly-available 5G capacity.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">Such partnerships would facilitate our deployment of a widescale PNT network and backup to GPS.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-align:justify; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><div style="-aw-sdt-tag:'PG_723519bcc5a0c20f'"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-align:center; font-size:10pt"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';  font-size: 10pt;">3</span></p><div><hr style="width: 100%; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; margin: 1rem 0;"/></div></div></div><div class="Section_10"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-weight:bold">Competition and Competitive Advantages</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">GPS and GNSS services are broadly used across a large number of both industries and specific use cases, however, multiple technologies provide, or are planned to provide, services to complement and backup GPS.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt"> Depending upon the specific use case, we both compete with and complement other geolocation services, as part of the &#8220;system of systems&#8221; required to provide a comprehensive solution to this market.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt"> Key technologies participating in this segment include enhanced long-range navigation (&#8220;eLORAN&#8221;), low Earth orbit (&#8220;LEO&#8221;) satellite systems, the</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">Broadcast</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">Positioning System (&#8220;BPS&#8221;) and various short-range commercial systems.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:48pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:-24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">eLORAN</span><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">is an advanced version of the World War II-era hyperbolic radio navigation system that was developed in response to the vulnerability of GNSS systems. eLORAN has historically been targeted towards maritime and aviation applications.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt"> If deployed, eLORAN may also be well-suited to long-range time distribution. </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">LEO Satellite Systems</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">offer primarily timing service based on signals transmitted from LEO satellite constellations. LEO systems potentially offer global coverage. However, for use cases requiring terrestrial signal strength, their signals are not as strong as those from terrestrial-based systems. LEO systems are subject to similar physical vulnerabilities as GPS.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">Commercial Location Systems, </span><span style="font-size:10pt">including legacy cellular systems, crowd-sourced systems and locally managed systems, are complements to GPS but generally rely on GPS or highly local surveys for their core performance. Most commercial location systems do not provide an independent timing source and are limited in their ability to be a viable backup to GPS.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">BPS</span><span style="font-size:10pt">, based on the Advanced Television Systems Committee standard and promoted by National Association of Broadcasters, aims to deliver terrestrial PNT service independent of GPS and is under development at the pilot stage. BPS signals will be transmitted from the broadcast infrastructure using ATSC 3.0.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">Subject to appropriate regulatory approvals, we believe that our NextGen solution offers a near-term terrestrial, widescale PNT solution that will be broadly available to critical infrastructure, public safety, and consumers, and has a clear path to incorporation in end-user devices.</span><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160; </span><span style="font-size:10pt">We believe our NextGen capability, subject to FCC approvals, will have a shorter time to market as a complement and backup to GPS than other solutions. In addition, because our NextGen solution leverages 5G networks, we anticipate the capital expenditures associated with the network deployment will be associated with our future 5G partnerships, and we do not plan to seek Federal appropriations for the deployment of our NextGen system. While no single solution can complement and backup all GPS use cases, we believe that we offer an important component to securing the nation&#8217;s PNT infrastructure.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-weight:bold">Network Operations</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">Our Pinnacle network is primarily operated in partnership with AT&amp;T. The Pinnacle altitude stations are co-located at AT&amp;T wireless sites and use the power systems, including battery backup and generators, at the AT&amp;T sites. We monitor the Pinnacle network health through our network operations center (&#8220;NOC&#8221;) and work with AT&amp;T to resolve any issues that may arise. Connectivity among the Pinnacle altitude stations, our cloud service platform, and our NOC are enabled through wireless connections, currently provided by AT&amp;T.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">We are not required to use AT&amp;T wireless sites for network expansion and may establish new service areas through independently acquired site leases or with other partners.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">Our TerraPoiNT network is deployed, operated, and maintained by us. The equipment is installed at traditional wireless sites with a mix of towers and rooftops. We monitor the network health through the same NOC as the Pinnacle network and directly dispatch</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">our employees or maintenance contractors if needed.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">As discussed, we&#8239;anticipate</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">operating our NextGen services in partnership with one or more</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">mobile network operators. We</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">anticipate</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">that the radio network infrastructure will be deployed by, and the broadband services</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">operated</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">by</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">those operators. We plan to</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">utilize</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">one or more partners&#8217; network</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">facilities to</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">operate</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">our PNT services, the signal for which will be embedded in the 5G NR broadband transmission.</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><div style="-aw-sdt-tag:'PG_b3c8b5eb397cfc01'"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-align:center; font-size:10pt"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';  font-size: 10pt;">4</span></p><div><hr style="width: 100%; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; margin: 1rem 0;"/></div></div></div><div class="Section_11"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-weight:bold">AT&amp;T Relationship</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">We have entered into a series of agreements with AT&amp;T to provide our Pinnacle services to FirstNet</span><span style="font-size:6.67pt; vertical-align:super">&#174;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">, built with AT&amp;T, and to enable the co-location of elements of our network at AT&amp;T&#8217;s wireless sites. By co-locating the Pinnacle equipment at AT&amp;T wireless sites, we were able to accelerate the nationwide deployment of our services and significantly reduce the ongoing operating costs associated with the Pinnacle system.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">Our AT&amp;T agreements provide for: (i) AT&amp;T&#8217;s marketing and resale of Pinnacle services to FirstNet</span><span style="font-size:6.67pt; vertical-align:super">&#174;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">subscribers and certain pricing requirements for our SDKs based on the quantity of usage, revenue sharing, compliance with data rights and privacy, and support requirements; and (ii) AT&amp;T hosting of Pinnacle equipment for altitude determination at AT&amp;T sites, at no recurring cost to us.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">We have provided AT&amp;T with performance assurances and certain intellectual property and transition support rights in the event we are unable to continue providing services to AT&amp;T, have significant service outages, or engage in transactions with certain persons. The parties also entered into escrow arrangements on customary terms for intellectual property storage and verification of the deposited escrow materials in various different escrow &#8220;lockers,&#8221; which could be accessed by AT&amp;T based on different conditions on which the draw down could be made.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">In 2019,</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">we entered into an equipment hosting agreement with AT&amp;T that has a seven-year term (subject to earlier termination after three years in certain circumstances), expiring in October 2028. Under the terms of the equipment hosting agreement, AT&amp;T is providing all site-related services during AT&amp;T&#8217;s continued use of the service. Our services agreement with AT&amp;T for distribution of our services to FirstNet</span><span style="font-size:6.67pt; vertical-align:super">&#174;</span><span style="font-size:10pt"> customers expires in October 2028. </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-weight:bold">Intellectual Property</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">Our ability to drive innovation in PNT services depends in part upon our ability to protect our core technologies and intellectual property. We rely upon a combination of patent, trademark, and trade secret laws in the United States and abroad, as well as license agreements and other contractual protections. As we expand service to additional countries and regions, we will become subject to additional governmental approvals and regulations. </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">Radio Spectrum</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">Certain of our services rely on the use of radio communications spectrum, which is regulated in the United States and in most other countries. In the United States, spectrum access is licensed and regulated by the FCC. We hold radio licenses issued by the FCC that authorize the use of 8 MHz of contiguous spectrum in the 900 MHz band covering more than 90% of the population in the United States, and an additional 4 MHz of M-LMS licenses in parts of the United States. These licenses and the FCC rules impose obligations on us regarding the use of this spectrum, including power and operational limits, coexistence, build-out, and usage requirements, and a license renewal obligation. We must comply with these requirements to retain access and use of these spectrum resources.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:23.75pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">On</span><span style="font-size:10pt">&#160;</span><span style="font-size:10pt">April 16, 2024, we filed a Petition for Rulemaking with the FCC, seeking to significantly accelerate and expand the availability of our PNT services as a complement and backup to GPS through an optimization of the Lower 900 MHz band. The Petition is subject to an ongoing FCC regulatory review process, and was referenced in the FCC&#8217;s March 27, 2025 PNT Notice of Inquiry.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">Privacy and Data Security</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">In developing highly accurate location information, we collect, process, transmit and store personal information, such as certain individual geolocation information, and other personal information relating to its business contacts, personnel, end users, and website visitors. A variety of federal and state laws and regulations govern the collection, use, retention, sharing and security of this information. The U.S. privacy and data protection legal landscape continues to evolve, with California and Virginia having enacted broad-based data privacy and protection legislation and with states and the federal government continuing to consider additional data privacy and protection legislation. As we expand overseas, our joint venture partners will be subject to foreign data privacy and protection legislation, and we may be as well. </span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><div style="-aw-sdt-tag:'PG_84885cdec4d2f485'"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-align:center; font-size:10pt"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';  font-size: 10pt;">6</span></p><div><hr style="width: 100%; color: #000000; background-color: #000000; margin: 1rem 0;"/></div></div></div><div class="Section_13"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">We understand that protection of data and privacy is critically important to the end-users of our services. Our core privacy principles are:</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">Transparency: We are transparent about our data practices, and we comply with our privacy policies and agreements so customers and business partners can make informed decisions.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">Control: We have implemented appropriate means for our customers and business partners to control relevant personal and business information.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-left:41.75pt; margin-bottom:6pt; text-indent:-18pt; line-height:12pt;"><span><span style="font-family:Symbol; font-size:10pt">&#61623;</span><span style="width:13.4pt; font:7pt 'Times New Roman'; display:inline-block;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </span></span><span style="font-size:10pt">Security: We endeavor to protect the data entrusted to us by using strong security protocols. Our data is encrypted both at rest (locally on the device and on the server) and in transit.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt; font-style:italic">Export</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt;">&#160;</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:24pt; line-height:12pt"><span style="font-size:10pt">Our business plans are based in part on the distribution of its services worldwide.
